newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen A shares end higher on rebound.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen A shares end higher on rebound.

text.p: Shenzhen's A share index recovered early losses and had a strong technical rebound late on Wednesday after sharp falls for four consecutive sessions, brokers said.
The A share index rose 7.25 points or 2.43 percent to close at 306.07 after hitting an intraday low of 282.59, on turnover of 5.44 billion yuan against Tuesday's 4.67 billion.
There was no trading in the Shenzhen B share market on Wednesday in line with the closure of the Hong Kong bourse due to the Christmas holiday. Trading will resume on Friday.

The rally was also due to a report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday denying rumours Beijing planned to replace the next-day settlement system on the country's two share markets with three-day settlement, brokers said.
Widespread rumours of a change sent A share prices sharply down on Tuesday, they said.
Buying on Wednesday focussed on counters that were listed in the second half of this year, brokers said.
Cement producer Guangxi Huwei rose 0.84 yuan to its limit-up of 9.19 yuan on speculative buying.

Property issue Hainan Minyuan also closed at its limit-up of 15.48 yuan on heavy trade of 14.31 million shares on demand from institutions optimistic about the company's earnings this year, brokers said.
